evidence.note: Agent commits early to a single monolithic src/main.rs hand-rolled implementation; this foundational bet is never revisited or restructured for the rest of the run.

Repeating loop of per-method python diagnosis (documentSymbol, foldingRange, references, hover, etc.) followed by apply_patch edits to src/main.rs — targeted local patches driven by fresh diagnosis of each failing piece, not blind repetition of the same edit.

Late-stage cycles remain the same tactic: small apply_patch to main.rs then cargo build && run_tests. No pivot in parsing strategy, symbol model, or build-vs-reuse; purely incremental patching of individual handlers to the end.

reasoning: Across the full horizon the agent stays within its initial single-file hand-rolled design, applying targeted local patches to individual method handlers after diagnosing each failure — this exceeds anchor 3's blind local patching (edits are materially different per piece rather than repeated, per anchor 5) but shows no evidence of questioning or reworking the foundational parser/symbol-model choice (anchor 8). Confidence is low because the trajectory file exposes only tool-call names and command descriptions, not the agent's reasoning prose or observations, so foundational-level deliberation cannot be fully ruled in or out.
